title: M5Stack Core2 v1.3 · K010-V13
summary: ESP32双核触摸终端；此SKU的电源管理、IMU、接口和修订差异由独立官方资料记录。

facts.label: SoC
facts.value: ESP32-D0WDQ6-V3 @ Xtensa® 32-bit LX6 dual-core processor, clock frequency 240MHz

facts.label: Buttons
facts.value: Power Button, RST Button, Screen Virtual Buttons x 3

facts.label: Charging Parameters
facts.value: Charging Current: 0.219A; Current After Full Charge (Power Off): 0.055A; Current When Fully Charged (Power On): 0.147A

facts.label: LCD 10-pin display connector nets

value.seriesResistors: 47R on MOSI/MISO/SCK/CS (R61-R64 in the v1.0 drawing)

facts.notes: RST and backlight are PMIC outputs, not ESP32 GPIOs: the driver must release reset and enable the backlight through the power IC named in this record.

facts.label: microSD socket nets

wiring: G4 (10K pull, R26 in the v1.0 drawing)
socket switch pad; no ESP32 net name visible in the text layer

facts.notes: The socket shares the SPI bus with the LCD panel; the two devices are separated by their chip selects (G4 vs G5).

facts.label: Internal I2C roster (G21 SDA / G22 SCL)

devices: INT on G39, RST on AXP_IO4

facts.notes: Official v1.3 PinMap: BMI270 replaces MPU6886 while the PMIC stays AXP192.

facts.label: I2S amplifier and PDM microphone
facts.notes: LRCK and the PDM clock share GPIO0: the I2S transmit path and the microphone PDM path cannot be sampled simultaneously on the same pad.

facts.label: RTC and its interrupt
facts.notes: The interrupt is a PMIC output, so an alarm cannot be observed from an ESP32 GPIO.

value.schematicNets: IMU_SDA / IMU_SCL pads on the U1 BMI270 symbol in the v1.3 drawing

value.select: SELECT pad is decoupled to a supply/ground net in the drawing, not driven by an ESP32 GPIO

facts.label: M5-Bus 2x15 header, pin by pin
facts.notes: Left column is odd pins 1-29, right column even pins 2-30; NC pads carry no net name.

facts.label: HY2.0-4P port wiring
facts.notes: PORT.B/PORT.C are reached through the 2x15 expansion header/bottom accessory; only PORT.A is a socket on the host body in the base SKU drawings.

value.indicator: Green power LED on AXP192 IO1

revisions.changes: Manufacturer release note: the LCD panel changed from ILI9342C to ILI9342E; M5GFX >= 0.2.27 is required when compiling. Both controller datasheets list a 320RGB x 240 window, so the geometry does not change but the initialization/ID path does.
revisions.hardwareRevision: v1.3 (AXP192, BMI270, ILI9342E required for units shipped after 2026-08-07).
